title: Block edits to tests
setup: Step-0 held-out, 24 trials, claude-haiku-5-5, paired bootstrap 95% interval
summary: The agent edited tests in 6 of its failed sessions. A PreToolUse hook blocks edits under tests/ and testing/, and edits to conftest.py.

title: Run tests before finishing
setup: Checkpoint forks, 8 forks, claude-haiku-5-5, diagnosis only
summary: In 5 failed sessions no test command ran after the last source edit. A skill asks the agent to run the task's tests before it ends the session.

title: Cap repeated whole-suite runs
setup: Step-0 held-out, 24 trials, claude-haiku-5-5, paired bootstrap 95% interval
summary: Nine of the most expensive sessions ran the whole test suite 4 or more times. A hook blocks the third whole-suite run and points to the failing test file.

title: Restate the requirement first
setup: Step-0 held-out, 24 trials, claude-haiku-5-5, paired bootstrap 95% interval
summary: Four failed sessions solved a neighbouring problem. An AGENTS.md rule asks the agent to restate the task before it edits. The result is within noise.

title: Keep notes in long sessions
summary: Three sessions repeat a read they made 30 or more turns earlier. This group is small, so the plan is monitoring plus rollback.
